cover: What an AI feature costs to run

slides.title: You pay per token
slides.body: A token is roughly four characters of English. You pay for what goes in and what comes back, and output costs more.

slides.title: Model choice moves the bill most
slides.body: On Anthropic's price list, Opus 5.5 input costs forty times what Haiku 5.5 costs for shorter requests.

slides.title: Cache what repeats
slides.body: Put fixed instructions and documents first. Cached input is billed at a fraction of the normal rate.

slides.title: Batch work that can wait
slides.body: Anthropic and OpenAI both offer batch processing at about half the normal price, with results later.

slides.title: Send less context
slides.body: The three most relevant articles, not the whole knowledge base. Every token you send is billed.

slides.title: Set limits before launch
slides.body: A budget per customer stops one heavy user or a looping bug from running up a bill nobody sees.
